applies_to: prereg/CORRECTED_STUDIES_20260920_v3 (frozen 2026-09-23); recorded before any scientific outcome

P1-G2.basis: Permitted consequence in ContinuumPlacementScopedDown.md (G2 failure/absence: 'claims narrow to that surface') and v1 PROTOCOL.md prerequisites ('or need an explicit permitted narrowing before execution').
withdrawn_claims: Decision conformance between the simulator scheduler and a real kube-scheduler on any event surface
Operational Kubernetes equivalence or deployability of the evolved policies
P1-G2.retained_reporting: The July G-K8s spike (claim ledger E3) may be described only as an engineering demonstration that the policy runtime executed inside a real kube-scheduler plugin on its recorded source and host, with its caveats; it is not conformance evidence.

P1-G3-cal.basis: Permitted consequence in ContinuumPlacementScopedDown.md ('G3-cal: narrow workload claims') and v1 PROTOCOL.md prerequisites.
withdrawn_claims: Per-request service-time or latency-tail validity of the Alibaba-derived fits
Any statement that the independent family is an empirically measured validation set
required_disclosures: All conclusions are conditional on the specified synthetic construction and partially calibrated model assumptions
Fit errors, including the selected fit's ~29.9% p95 bias, and the unresolved tail-precision criterion
Energy-model sensitivity (e.g. CPU attribution 0.30 vs 0.60 flips historical feasibility)

scorer-latency-gate.rationale: The 5 ms p99 budget governs execution-cost claims, not the validity of the A/B search comparison. The budget is not revised post hoc.
evidence_retained: 2026-09-18 suite: four seed policies at 5.265-6.853 ms p99
2026-09-23 full suite under concurrent load: latency_greedy p99 6.888 ms
scorer-latency-gate.commitment: After final selection, measure every selected policy and fixed reference on an otherwise idle, identified machine: decision latency p50/p99, memory and code size, under the unchanged gate. Report failures. Any 'lightweight' wording is limited to these measured values.

prompt-bare-expression-repairs.rationale: The recurring bare-expression parse error is repaired within the registered repair loop, the projected cost fits the ceiling ($44.12 with reserve), and changing the prompt would alter the frozen treatment. Repair rates are reported as operator-health outcomes.
